Fail CI on contradictory latest-state claims.

findings.summary: Expected logical schedule slot, actual dispatch identity, lateness/miss classification and downstream completion must remain distinguishable.
findings.difference_reason: ERP4 proves the ambiguity through a very-late successful native run, while AI Core has adjacent recovery/SLA semantics but no reusable solved logical-slot identity implementation.

findings.summary: FreePass Admin consumes C Application Service contracts in SHADOW/PARTIAL form but lacks verified production persistence, actor-provider, durable receipt and runtime bindings.

breaking_impact: Development bindings can be mistaken for production conformance.
Actor/authentication authority can be overstated while the production provider is unbound.
Critical mutations can report success without durable Core receipt/provenance proof.
Release claims can exceed exact production runtime evidence.
verification_needs: Bind exact production persistence adapters.
Bind a fail-closed production ActorProvider.
Prove critical-write idempotency and durable receipt evidence.
Prove production audit retention.
Prove exact release/runtime revision before promotion.

Admin D6 head advances workflow SHADOW evidence but does not close the existing production C binding gap.

findings.summary: ERP4/ERP5 implements and CI-verifies a Core ingest receipt shadow, but receipt build/upload is non-blocking and production scheduled receipt evidence remains unverified.

breaking_impact: A supplier PARTIAL/FAILED apply can still finish without durable machine receipt if the shadow evidence path fails.
Downstream recovery can lack authoritative partial-state provenance.
Operational status can diverge from supplier-level receipt state.
CI-only proof can be mistaken for production receipt conformance.
verification_needs: Observe retained receipt artifacts from real production ERP5 refresh runs at an exact project revision.
Verify receipt schema conformance and sensitive-data exclusion.
Verify PARTIAL and FAILED behavior with real or controlled evidence.
Verify retention and retrievability.
Define fail-closed behavior when a required receipt cannot be built or uploaded.
Add publication-orchestration receipt if the C boundary requires it.

state_history.reason: Receipt shadow is implemented and CI-verified but remains non-blocking and lacks exact-head production observation.
ERP4 advanced only the Audit80 ledger documentation; the existing migration gap remains unchanged.

findings.summary: ERP4 SSOT Source Contract checks C shadow surfaces on pull requests but omits the same paths from main push filters, leaving a fail-open enforcement gap.

breaking_impact: A main-only change to C shadow contracts, projection code or checker can bypass the resulting-main Source Contract run.
PR success cannot be treated as fail-closed enforcement while main has no required status checks.
verification_needs: Make push path coverage include the same C shadow surfaces as pull_request coverage or establish an equivalent fail-closed main gate.
Add a negative/trigger fixture proving a shadow-only main change schedules the Source Contract workflow.
Observe a green resulting-main run at the exact fixed revision.

state_history.reason: Audit80 proves pull-request and main-push path filters are asymmetric for the new C shadow surfaces.
ERP4 advanced only the Audit80 ledger documentation; the existing migration gap remains unchanged.

findings.summary: FreePass Sales has an exact-revision B consumer mapping but remains MAPPED without revision-bound B4 conformance receipts and the required locale, RTL, IME and viewport evidence.

breaking_impact: MAPPED UI can be misreported as PILOT or CONFORMANT without revision-bound evidence.
Localization, RTL, IME and responsive behavior can be overstated outside the verified matrix.
A copied product mapping can be mistaken for B canonical behavior.
verification_needs: Keep exact-head consumer mapping CI green.
Produce a revision-bound B4 conformance receipt.
Complete locale, RTL and IME probes required by the consumer mapping.
Retain full rendered evidence for the declared viewport matrix.
Bind production-conformance claims to an exact released revision.

state_history.reason: Sales mapping is implemented and CI-verified but conformance receipt evidence remains incomplete.

breaking_impact: SMS application launch can be mistaken for business completion.

verification_needs: Bind customer search to the intended production read boundary and prove fail-closed behavior.
Persist and retrieve promotion receipts in the real runtime.
Verify HOLD, PARTIAL and SUCCEEDED with controlled or production evidence.
Verify retention and sensitive-data exclusion.
Bind runtime evidence to the exact deployed Sales revision before promotion beyond SHADOW.

state_history.reason: Sales C adapter and receipt semantics are implemented and CI-verified but remain SHADOW/NON-BLOCKING without production observation.
